proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a one-shot variable reduction to the triggering hit's damage, which is not representable by existing atoms like damage, grant_resistance, or negate_named_effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

proposed_widenings.name: reaction hit_by_attack_roll qualifier for thrown weapons
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing trigger filter vocabulary cannot honestly encode "Ranged or Thrown weapon" because WeaponFilter only admits melee/ranged categories or a specific item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon

notes: No content file was authored. The top-level shape fits a reaction-based magic-item activation, but the core damage-reduction mechanic is missing from the atom surface. The catch-on-zero rider is also unmodeled and was not forced into a placeholder encoding.
